name: Aoi Matsuri procession paid seats
intro: The Aoi Matsuri is one of Kyoto's three great festivals: a procession in Heian-period court dress on May 15. Paid seats along the route give you a reserved view of the procession.

facts.bookAhead: About six weeks: 2026 seats went on sale on April 1

statusNote: The 2026 sale date is from the Kyoto City Tourism Association's official site. The 2027 date is not announced yet; we show the 2026 date as a guide.
howToBuy: The Kyoto City Tourism Association sells paid seats for the Aoi Matsuri procession on May 15.
In 2026, seats went on sale at 10:00 Japan time on April 1, online through Ticket Pia's English site.
Regular seats cost ¥5,000 to ¥6,500. Royal seats cost ¥18,000 to ¥20,000.
rulesToKnow: If it rains, the procession moves to May 16.
The 2027 sale date has not been announced. We will update this page when it is.

soldOut.label: Watch from the street for free along the route

faq.q: When do Aoi Matsuri seats go on sale?
faq.a: In 2026 they went on sale at 10:00 Japan time on April 1. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.
